title: Philips DDL240X-1HB Bluetooth Fingerprint Smart Deadbolt

comparisons.notes: Exact model DDL240X-1HB-SN, Philips 4000 Series Bluetooth fingerprint deadbolt in satin nickel, lock only. Page shows $99.90 and 'In stock, ready to ship'. Matched to Woot's item by ASIN, UPC 850048306332 and model.

writeup: The Philips DDL240X-1HB Bluetooth fingerprint smart deadbolt in satin nickel is $58.99 new on Woot. It unlocks by fingerprint, PIN code, the phone app or a physical key, stores up to 50 fingerprints and auto-locks when the door closes. Philips' own store sells the same lock for $99.90, and Woot showed just 1 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Woot's ASIN B0CLGV56TF is the Philips DDL240X-1HB satin nickel lock, UPC 850048306332, same model as Philips' DDL240X-1HB-SN.
